evals.prompt: Add a notifications popover to my Next.js app. There's a bell button in the header; clicking it opens a small card with a list of notifications (title + timestamp each). Use Tailwind, and it needs to look right in light and dark mode.
evals.expected_output: Markup uses semantic tokens (bg-popover or bg-card, text-foreground / text-muted-foreground, border-border, rounded-lg) with no hand-rolled `dark:` color pairs, no raw palette utilities standing in for roles (bg-white, text-gray-500), and no arbitrary values for on-scale spacing (no p-[16px], rounded-[8px]).

evals.prompt:
Clean up my tailwind in this component, it's drifted:
Online
evals.expected_output: Reads references/cleanup.md and follows its process and output format. Auto-applies only the mechanical fixes (flex-row removed, px-4 py-4 -> p-4, w-5 h-5 -> size-5, p-[16px] -> p-4). Flags but does not change: bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 (token-drift candidate), text-sm text-lg (duplicate-property pair — asks which was intended rather than keeping the last one), rounded-[8px] (rounded-md candidate).

evals.prompt: Fresh Vite + React + TS project. Set up Tailwind v4 with a dark mode toggle and the usual shadcn token theme.
evals.expected_output: Reads references/setup.md before writing CSS. Entry uses @import "tailwindcss" (not @tailwind directives), dark mode via @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)), tokens bridged with @theme inline and stored as complete oklch() values in :root / .dark. Asks the user before choosing the cn() implementation and before restoring cursor-pointer on buttons, rather than assuming either.

evals.prompt: Why isn't bg-opacity-50 doing anything in my project? Also add a hover state to my custom .btn utility class.
evals.expected_output: Emits zero v3 patterns: replaces bg-opacity-50 with the /50 modifier (bg-primary/50 or equivalent), and puts the custom utility in @utility (not @layer utilities) so hover:btn exists. If the project turns out to be genuinely on Tailwind v3, says so explicitly first instead of silently mixing idioms.

evals.prompt: Review this Tailwind for me: <button className="shadow rounded ring outline-none [&:hover]:scale-105">Save</button>
evals.expected_output: Does NOT apply the v3->v4 rename table: shadow, rounded, ring, and outline-none are left alone (no shadow-sm / rounded-sm / ring-3 / outline-hidden rewrites). Does NOT canonicalize [&:hover]: to hover: (the named variant wraps @media (hover: hover)). Any feedback given is about real issues only.
